changes.change: appended rules to system prompt: ['Always include all specific details, including makers, brands, and manufacturers mentioned alongside parts in the source text.', 'Ensure answers are fully comprehensive by cross-checking all descriptive attributes associated with the requested item in the context.']
changes.why: The failure was caused by omitting a key detail (the maker 'Yanmar') present in the context. Adding rules to capture all associated attributes and makers prevents incomplete answers.

changes.change: appended rules to system prompt: ['When explaining supplier terms and conditions regarding returns, explicitly state all qualifying conditions, restrictions, and exceptions mentioned in the source text rather than giving a generalized summary.', 'Carefully verify the exact scope of supplier policies and do not omit crucial qualifying clauses such as error attribution when answering questions about returns or warranties.']

These rules target completeness and precision in extracting policy details without hallucinating.
